title: Autonomous grading work using deep reinforcement learning based control
command_path_summary: Task- or planner-level learned decisions
final_evaluation_summary: Evaluation removes epsilon-greedy randomness and permits up to 1,000 actions. Three cited checkpoints leave zero holes; the best selected checkpoint takes 335 actions. A human simulator route takes 452 actions and is described as the best among many trials, whose denominator and protocol are not stated.
supported_operating_scope: Supports route selection in one discrete fixed-layout grading simulator with the stated actions and reward. Machine dynamics, blade-soil control, changed sand states, repeated reliability, physical execution, safeguards, recovery, and construction workflow remain outside scope.

title: Simulation-based reinforcement learning approach towards construction machine automation
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: The best saved policy from each condition is tested in 100 simulated trials. Success is threshold-defined for sway reduction or simulated bucket fill; the source reports method-level success percentages but no hardware execution, multi-seed uncertainty, or construction workflow test.
supported_operating_scope: Supports the reported Vortex crane-sway and single-bucket-loading abstractions and their method-level success percentages. It does not support sim-to-real robustness, physical machine control, site disturbance tolerance, autonomous failure recovery, or continued construction operation.

title: Route optimization for autonomous bulldozer by distributed deep reinforcement learning
command_path_summary: Task- or planner-level learned decisions
final_evaluation_summary: The highest average-filling-rate checkpoints are tested on 36 initial sediment positions arranged at 0.5 m increments, including positions not used for learning. Table II compares mean train/test filling rates for PPO and PPO+LSTM.
supported_operating_scope: Supports route selection for the stated continuous-height sediment simulator and held-out initial-position range. It does not support full bulldozer motion control, real soil grading, runtime safety, physical generalization, or recovery after execution failure.

title: Soil-Adaptive Excavation Using Reinforcement Learning
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Simulation evaluates soft, medium, and hard soil parameters. Physical experiments repeat each reported scenario multiple times in soft-to-medium soil, with close-to-machine initialization, and with a buried granite block that creates an abrupt hard-to-soft transition; exact per-scenario repeat counts are not stated in the extracted text.
supported_operating_scope: Supports adaptive single-scoop excavation on the reported 12-ton platform, standard-valve control stack, horizontal-ground assumption, tested initialization range, and soil transitions. It does not support unattended operation, arbitrary buried-object handling, slope/cabin-turn generalization, autonomous retry, or sustained excavation workflow resumption.

title: A general approach for the automation of hydraulic excavator arms using reinforcement learning
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Physical tests include circular trajectories of 1.5 m diameter at three average speeds, five horizontal trajectories at two speeds, three- and four-joint controller variants, comparison with the Leica semi-automatic controller in air, and a prescribed four-waypoint grading trajectory with soil contact.
supported_operating_scope: Supports task-space arm tracking and one controlled grading trajectory on the reported machine, actuator-data range, planar cabin-relative motion, and control stack. It does not support autonomous grading-path generation, independent safety enforcement, arbitrary soil disturbance adaptation, recovery after contact, or sustained construction workflow operation.

title: Excavation reinforcement learning using geometric representation
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Simulation evaluation uses 100 episodes and 1,000 planned excavations per learned method. Physical evaluation uses five episodes of five sequential excavations for each learned method, reporting planning validity, execution success, and excavated volume.
supported_operating_scope: Supports sequential attacking-pose planning and bounded physical execution on the reported Franka/tray apparatus, object set, reduced path lengths, and five-action episodes. It does not support hydraulic excavator deployment, reactive contact control, autonomous recovery from sticking, or sustained material-loading production.

title: Deep reinforcement learning with adversarial training for automated excavation using depth images
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: During training, policies are tested every 5,000 steps using ten episodes without exploration and averaged across five seeds. Task progress above 90% defines simulated success. The extracted text reports comparative curves and Table 1, whose exact numeric entries require direct visual verification.
supported_operating_scope: Supports depth-image trajectory planning and critic-regularization comparisons in the stated fixed-soil simulator. It does not support robustness to soil-parameter changes, physical excavator control, safety under adversarial conditions, or autonomous failure recovery.

title: AGPNet -- Autonomous Grading Policy Network
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Eight algorithm variants are evaluated on 50 independently generated runs for each of three simulated scenario types. The combined RL+BC+CL method is compared with the SnP heuristic across height, volume, step, and total-reward metrics.
supported_operating_scope: Supports high-level waypoint learning in the reported numerical simulator and physical comparison of sand-height-map evolution on a 1:9 prototype. It does not support learned-policy execution on hardware, full-scale grading, runtime safety, or post-failure recovery.

title: Towards Autonomous and Optimal Excavation of Shield Machine: A Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Approach
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Agents are evaluated on historical indices 300,000--450,000 not used during training. Actions are constrained to the range used by human operators on the same segment. Model-generated advance speed, energy, reward, and action sequences are compared with recorded human operation.
supported_operating_scope: Supports hierarchical policy/controller analysis and held-out historical-sequence evaluation for the reported machine model and project data. It does not support autonomous physical TBM excavation, verified field savings, cross-project generalization, safe operator handover, or recovery from tunnelling faults.

title: Autonomous pick-and-place using excavator based on deep reinforcement learning
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: The paper validates one stated initial-to-target pose and then a prescribed six-target pick-and-place trajectory, reporting coordinate-wise pose RMSE. It does not state an independent test distribution, repeated-run denominator, seed count, or uncertainty interval.
supported_operating_scope: Supports PPO task-space tracking in the stated PyBullet excavator model and waypoint sequence. It does not support physical material handling, real-excavator accuracy, autonomous safety, or workflow recovery.

title: Learning excavation of rigid objects with offline reinforcement learning
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Physical policies are executed for ten trials in each reported material/scenario. Evaluation records trajectory reward, penetration duration, average/maximal contact force, and jamming-free rate under varied allowable-force criteria across five training terrains and unseen fragmented rocks.
supported_operating_scope: Supports laboratory penetration-policy learning and bounded fine-tuning for the reported Franka, primitive set, six materials, and force-limited controller. It does not support complete excavation planning, automatic post-halt recovery, hydraulic-excavator transfer, or sustained production.

title: Learning adaptive policies for autonomous excavation under various soil conditions by adversarial domain sampling
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Four typical soil domains and uniformly sampled domains are evaluated. Reported curves average five random seeds with 30 test episodes and show a 90 percent confidence region; Table II reports performance after 400,000 steps.
supported_operating_scope: Supports hard-domain sampling and latent soil-parameter adaptation in the stated simulator, parameter ranges, and arc-action abstraction. It does not support adversarial-site safety, noisy physical sensing, excavator deployment, or autonomous recovery.

title: Reinforcement learning-based bucket filling for autonomous excavation
command_path_summary: Learned joint-velocity references converted to piston-velocity references and tracked by PID plus feedforward valve-flow control.
final_evaluation_summary: Simulation ablations compare torque and explicit-soil observations across five seeds and about 12,500 initialized episodes for penetration analysis. Hardware evaluation includes five consecutive scoops per soil/constraint scenario and three autonomous trench trials with different accuracy thresholds.
supported_operating_scope: Supports full-scale bucket filling and nominal trench completion on the reported machine, loose previously excavated trench soil, sensing/control stack, and tested soil/constraint scenarios. It does not support unattended operation, immovable-rock handling, heterogeneous subsurface recovery, hard enforcement of every bound, or resumption after a physical failure.

title: Automatic loading of unknown material with a wheel loader using reinforcement learning
command_path_summary: Lift, tilt and throttle commands from a learned loading controller; safety-driver manual abort remains available (III.D).
final_evaluation_summary: Controllers are evaluated after each ten-episode block using ten bucket fillings per controller, reporting mean and standard deviation of material weight and loading time against a human-operator baseline.
supported_operating_scope: Supports delay-aware physical fine-tuning and noise-free evaluation of a lift--tilt--throttle bucket-filling controller on the reported full-size machine and target gravel pile, with safety-driver abort authority. Does not establish an activated abort, event-linked recovery, navigation/dumping cycles, or multi-site generalization.

title: Optimizing bucket-filling strategies for wheel loaders inside a dream environment
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: The world-model policy, imitation baseline, and target-pile-fine-tuned baseline each run ten physical trials on the same pile and day; a human expert provides a comparison. Outcomes are loaded mass, loading time, and successful bucket filling defined as not getting stuck.
supported_operating_scope: Supports direct full-size bucket-filling execution for the reported L576, gravel-like pile, phase logic, historical-data envelope, and ten-trial protocol. It does not support arbitrary material transfer, online world-model adaptation, autonomous failed-scoop recovery, or sustained loading workflow.

title: Task Space Control of Hydraulic Construction Machines Using Reinforcement Learning
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: One 30 s predefined multi-joint signal sequence compares simulated and measured motion. Physical task-space evaluation applies separate prescribed x-, y-, and z-velocity sequences to the RL and Jacobian-based controllers; repeat counts and uncertainty are not reported.
supported_operating_scope: Supports free-space task-space velocity control on the reported fixed-base Brokk 170, PWM cap, actuator-data range, and prescribed sequences. It does not support tool-loaded construction work, mobile operation, independent collision/singularity safety, human-performance benefit, or recovery.

title: Physics-informed deep reinforcement learning for enhancement on tunnel boring machine's advance speed and stability
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: The learned policy is compared with recorded manual operation over the last 146 ring conditions and with physics ablations, pDDPG, and TD3 variants. Outcomes are model-predicted advance speed, chamber-pressure balance, and action distributions.
supported_operating_scope: Supports physics-constrained model-based optimization for the reported C885 data, selected variables, and virtual ring sequence. It does not support autonomous EPB-TBM execution, field safety improvement, cross-geology transfer, independent safeguarding, or recovery.

title: Automated position control of tunnel boring machine during excavation using deep reinforcement learning
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: TD3 and DDPG outputs are compared with manual records over 500 held-out sample conditions. Outcomes include learned-environment horizontal and vertical tail deviations and distributions of four cylinder-group thrust forces.
supported_operating_scope: Supports time-series learned-environment optimization for the reported 200-ring project section, feature set, and held-out sequence. It does not support autonomous TBM steering, physical safety benefit, cross-project generalization, independent protection, or recovery.

title: Generalized Framework for Wheel Loader Automatic Shoveling Task with Expert Initialized Reinforcement Learning
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: One hundred randomized simulated episodes compare CoL and TD3 fill rate. Physical evaluation reports five attempts on wet soil and five on medium-coarse gravel; two gravel attempts fail for unspecified safety issues. Joint trajectories are compared between simulation and experiment.
supported_operating_scope: Supports expert-initialized, inverse-dynamics-mediated shoveling on the reported loader and two material conditions under a ten-attempt protocol. It does not support failure-safe autonomy, stable pile-independent performance, automatic recovery, navigation/dumping cycles, or general wheel-loader robustness.

title: 3d operation of autonomous excavator based on reinforcement learning through independent reward for individual joints
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Physical point-chasing covers four linear and three sloped trajectories at different mean heights and is compared once with corresponding skilled-operator paths. Outcomes are mean and maximum bucket-tip errors for each prescribed trajectory; repeat counts and uncertainty are not reported.
supported_operating_scope: Supports four-joint free-space bucket-tip tracking on the reported secured DX225LC-7 and prescribed trajectory set. It does not support autonomous excavation, grading quality, payload handling, independent physical safety, failure recovery, or sustained operation.

title: Safe reinforcement learning for tracking control of uncertain hydraulic excavators
command_path_summary: Residual learning within classical control
final_evaluation_summary: One reported physical 5-s reference trajectory moves boom and arm while bucket and slew remain stationary. Bucket-tip and cylinder tracking traces are shown; repetitions, uncertainty, material displacement, and comparison under a physical disturbance are not reported.
supported_operating_scope: Supports continuous BLF-mediated hydraulic tracking for the stated model assumptions, initial-bound condition, platform parameters, and short reference test. It does not support certified task safety, collision avoidance, material-process robustness, emergency response, or recovery.

title: Towards Learning Boulder Excavation with Hydraulic Excavators
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Simulation tests span 50 scanned geometries and soft/hard soil parameters; a held-out test uses 25 unseen 0.8--1.0 m rock geometries in hard soil; the learned controller is compared with a continuous-excavation RL baseline.
supported_operating_scope: The policy receives proprioceptive variables and a sparse cloud of 20 three-dimensional points. Supports single-target boulder acquisition with a standard bucket on the reported fixed-base 12-ton excavator, tested rock sizes, soil classes, manually initialized segmentation, and 40-trial protocol; does not support recovery from complete occlusion, autonomous multi-rock clearing, or sustained workflow resumption.

title: Reinforcement Learning-Based Autonomous Control Methodology of Hydraulic Excavators
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Case A compares eight-hour fixed-50-Hz and ACF training, yielding about 40k versus 110k steps. Cases B and C assess pump-flow reward and untrained workload/valve response. A depicted 26-s simulated sequence completes approach, digging, lifting, and dumping.
supported_operating_scope: Supports simulation-only study of valve-level PPO, adaptive control frequency, shaped constraint penalties, and zero-shot modeled load variation. It does not support physical excavation, hard safety enforcement, failure recovery, or construction productivity.

title: Progressive-resolution policy distillation: Leveraging coarse-resolution simulations for time-efficient fine-resolution policy learning
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Nine rock types (five wooden shapes and three differently sized printed artificial rocks as described in the source table, with the ninth object requiring direct table verification) are crossed with three ground materials. Each cell reports 20 trials from five policies at four positions; success requires the rock held in the bucket with the bucket off the ground.
supported_operating_scope: Supports progressive-resolution training and direct laboratory rock pickup for the reported UR5e, objects, granular beds, sensing, and 20-trial cells. It does not support full-scale excavation, excavator productivity, autonomous recovery, or general site robustness.

title: Enhanced Hydraulic Excavator Control via Semi-automatic Grading Control Using Reinforcement Learning
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Fine-grading simulation covers a 5 m target and 10 s cycle. Ten random 10 s test trajectories evaluate the forward model. RL versus manual-pattern RMSE is 0.023 versus 0.041 m and 0.392 versus 1.357 degrees.
supported_operating_scope: Supports semi-automatic 10 s grading in the stated simulator and controller partition only.

title: Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning to Track Excavation Paths for a Hydraulic Excavator in a Short Period of Time
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Post-training safety evaluation extends the gravelly-active-A controller for 128 consecutive excavation episodes (28,618 steps, 38 minutes); fill-ratio evaluation uses three target BFRs and ten trials per target for available cases.
supported_operating_scope: Supports short-duration human-assisted online adaptation and autonomous post-training path tracking for the reported excavator, homogeneous soils, fixed soil-pit sensing, hard-coded five-phase paths, and conservative pitch requirement; does not support unattended learning, heterogeneous soil transfer, autonomous post-failure recovery, or general excavation planning.

title: Adaptive Excavation Automation in Complex Soil Environments Using Reinforcement Learning
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Random soft, medium, and hard parameter ranges assess force-limit success. A 20-by-50 three-zone global task uses ten repeated trials per model; proposed MAE is 0.065 m and resistance improves 18.1% over baselines.
supported_operating_scope: Supports static-per-cycle analytical soil parameter ranges and the reported grid, not rapidly changing or unknown site soil.

title: Reinforcement learning-based trajectory planning for continuous digging of excavator working devices in trenching tasks
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Four simulation conditions report sub-0.5 s planning, excavation rate above 92%, and composite metrics below 0.14. MBD--DEM shows three successive Condition-1 excavations with slippage-related contour deviation.
supported_operating_scope: Supports the reported mathematical and MBD--DEM environments; no claim extends to prototype tracking or nonuniform material.

title: Time-optimal online trajectory planning for excavator robotics based on reinforcement learning
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: One trimming-plane target compares convergence, training time, reward, smoothness, and modeled completion time across DDPG, TRPO, TD3, and improved TD3.
supported_operating_scope: Supports the stated PC1012 dimensions and MATLAB kinematic task only.

title: Collaborative learning architecture for autonomous excavator planning and execution
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: 1,000 training plus 1,000 unseen trajectories; 1,000 random terrains; 100 repeated trajectory trials; 50 integrated soft/hard mound trials.
supported_operating_scope: Supports the reported randomized heightfields and soft/hard virtual mounds; completion thresholds partly reflect similarity to simulated experts.

title: Solving robotics tasks with prior demonstration via exploration-efficient deep reinforcement learning
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Simulation reports rewards averaged over five episodes. Physical evaluation comprises 25 post-redesign trials.
supported_operating_scope: Supports wet sand and stone under the stated loader, controller, and operator partition; not learned navigation or autonomous travel speed.

title: Large-Scale Robotic Material Handling: Learning, Planning, and Control
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: The integrated pile-transfer evaluation reports more than 20 repeated cycles with grasp, transport and unloading sequenced by the state machine. Component tests and the truck-loading variant provide separate supporting evidence, not the basis of the L5 recovery assessment.
supported_operating_scope: Supports workflow-integrated repeated pile transfer on the fixed-base handler within manually specified source and dump regions. Truck loading is a separate evaluated variant. Mobile-base operation, adaptive safety margins and recovery after module failure are not established.

title: Digital twin--enabled real-time control of tunnel boring machines using deep reinforcement learning for cumulative settlement management
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Virtual alignment comparison reports reward/settlement of 3813/2.34 mm with MCTS, 2303/4.30 mm without MCTS, and 2152/5.16 mm for NSGA-II.
supported_operating_scope: Supports the Nanjing model, two pressure actions, and modeled settlement/cost trade-offs; attitude, thrust, torque, advance rate, and policy execution are outside scope.

title: Intelligent attitude control in tunnel boring machine considering uncertain underground environment using deep reinforcement learning
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Two hundred nominal trials; 200 ultimate-capacity trials; project-profile replays; ten-segment manual comparison; six settlement bands with 200 trials each.
supported_operating_scope: Supports the elastic approximation, project-derived profiles, and stated settlement bands; not rebound, loading-path effects, actuator dynamics, or field execution.

title: Reinforcement learning control for autonomous hydraulic material handling machines with underactuated tools
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Physical tests issue steady-state references at 15 s intervals. Slew-only policies are compared with tuned PI control; full end-effector sequences are compared with a 15-year operator and a 0.5--2-year operator. Empty and loaded cases also remove load estimation. Tables report metrics averaged over different runs, but do not disclose a uniform trial count. Evaluation measures slew speed, overshoot, target error, and tool angular velocity rather than grasp or material throughput.
supported_operating_scope: Supports full-scale sim-to-real target tracking and oscillation damping for the reported hydraulic handler under controlled empty and loaded conditions. It does not support autonomous collision-free material handling, grasping reliability, fault recovery, or production workflow continuity.

title: Data-driven rock capture with a standard excavator via model-free reinforcement learning
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Three sets of 100 AGX Dynamics episodes evaluate the training condition, unseen rock geometries, and unseen sand material, reporting success rates of 0.79, 0.77, and 0.67. Each episode is limited to 500 steps, approximately 8.3 s.
supported_operating_scope: Supports simulated contact-rich rock capture for the reported excavator model under bounded geometry and material variation with exact rock-centre-of-mass observations. It does not support autonomous free-space approach, vision-based state estimation, hydraulic transfer, physical operation, or failure recovery.

title: Teaching robots to perform quasi-repetitive construction tasks through human demonstration
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Sixty virtual initial scenes use varied grid and tile staging positions. Success requires final non-overlap below 30 cubic centimetres; 47 of 60 trials succeed.
supported_operating_scope: Supports the stated Gazebo KUKA emulator, tile and grid geometry, fixed viewpoint, and visual demonstrations; physical contact, alignment inspection, force control, varied cameras, and unseen tile shapes remain outside scope.

title: Robotic assembly of timber joints using reinforcement learning
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: The trained policies are rolled out in simulation and on hardware across joint angle, notch gap, initial linear/angular offset, and single- versus double-lap geometry. Figure-level trial counts require direct visual verification.
supported_operating_scope: Supports low-speed final insertion of the reported spruce half-lap specimens on one ABB workcell, within tested angle, gap, and offset ranges. It does not support complete frame assembly, structural acceptance, sub-millimetre tight fits across geometries, post-jam recovery, or continued production after abort.

title: Robotic architectural assembly with tactile skills: Simulation and optimization
command_path_summary: TD3 supplies six target arm-joint velocities and a gripper-closure command for a bounded stacking skill in simulation.
final_evaluation_summary: TD3 is evaluated on 1,000 unseen simulated structures every 100,000 training steps; the reported block-position error is approximately 8 mm. The separate self-supervised tactile-transition-model/MPC hardware experiment achieves 19 of 30 joins and is not physical validation of this TD3 configuration.
supported_operating_scope: Supports simulated stacking with randomized block goals and grasps. Episode distance and time termination do not disclose an independent execution-time safeguard. Physical tactile MPC results are retained only as a distinct qualitative architecture.

title: A reinforcement learning based approach for conducting multiple tasks using robots in virtual construction environments
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Each task receives 50,000 inference action steps. Success is reported as episode-level pick and place percentages, but exact episode counts and independent seeds are not stated.
supported_operating_scope: Supports Unity pick-and-place of modeled 15 kg panels within the virtual arm workspace; physical transfer, contact, fastening, sensing uncertainty, and accepted installation quality remain outside scope.

title: Deep reinforcement learning-based construction robots collaboration for sequential tasks
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Ten batches of 100 randomized UGV starts evaluate arrival, pickup, and geometric installation. Aggregate counts are 975, 948, and 796 successes.
supported_operating_scope: Supports the simplified PyBullet UGV--KUKA sequence and geometric placement criterion; physical collaboration, sensing, fastening, simultaneous coordination, and failure recovery remain outside scope.

title: Learning robotic manipulation of natural materials with variable properties for construction tasks
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Seen/unseen simulated configurations report above 80% success and the stated generalization drops; physical trials are unquantified demonstrations.
supported_operating_scope: Supports the two tasks on the reported hanging robot and bamboo demonstrator, not autonomous bamboo construction or fault recovery.

title: Dexterous manipulation of construction tools using anthropomorphic robotic hand
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: The pretrained mug policy is first tested in 2,000 attempts per tool. Fine-tuned policies are evaluated over seven tool scales, including six unseen scales; the downstream toolbox task is evaluated in 50 trials.
supported_operating_scope: Supports the stated MuJoCo Adroit hand, six modeled tools, scale sweep, and virtual toolbox geometry; physical tools, tool operation, sensing uncertainty, safety, and construction-task completion remain outside scope.

title: To imitate or not to imitate: Boosting reinforcement learning-based construction robotic control for long-horizon tasks using virtual demonstrations
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Ten agents are evaluated on the randomized-start task. Reported counts sum to 9,981 pickups and 9,392 geometric installations across 10,000 agent-trials; a no-demonstration comparator achieves no success under the shorter episode limit.
supported_operating_scope: Supports the simplified PyBullet KUKA task, exact simulator state, automatic attachment, and fixed wall target; physical sensing, collision, contact, fastening, standards, and recovery remain outside scope.

title: Reinforcement learning-based virtual fixtures for teleoperation of hydraulic construction machine
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Five novices perform one guided and one unguided hammer-insertion condition, apparently in a fixed guided-first order, with participant-specific start and target positions. End-effector paths and NASA-TLX means are shown.
supported_operating_scope: Supports supervised Brokk teleoperation for the stated 8 cm into 10 cm borehole task, fixed perception arrangement, and five-person sample only.

title: Enhancing construction robot learning for collaborative and long-horizon tasks using generative adversarial imitation learning
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Each trained model is evaluated for 1,000 trials on its individual subtask. Randomized installation is also rescored after relaxing position and orientation thresholds from 0.05 to 0.1.
supported_operating_scope: Supports the stated virtual UGV and two-arm environments, coordinate randomization, and geometric thresholds; collision, physical sensing, end-to-end coordination, fastening, standards, and recovery remain outside scope.

title: Visual spatial attention and proprioceptive data-driven reinforcement learning for robust peg-in-hole task under variable conditions
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Offline evaluation totals 5,760 tests per model. Physical online results report 93.9 plus or minus 0.7% and 8.21 plus or minus 0.22 s, with denominator unstated.
supported_operating_scope: Supports the specified anchor-bolt rig, not active-site deployment or multi-bolt workflow continuity.

title: Training of construction robots using imitation learning and environmental rewards
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Each policy is executed 100 times in the performance table. Group 4 reports 97% installation and Group 8 reports 82%; physical replication is unstated.
supported_operating_scope: Supports laboratory trajectory learning with terminal IK, not full window installation or recovery.

title: Visual--tactile learning of robotic cable-in-duct installation skills
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Four physical experiments per method, pipe diameter, and grasp mode. FSTR-Net rough/precise success is 100/100%, 100/100%, and 50/100% for 25, 20, and 16 mm pipes.
supported_operating_scope: Supports the reported sensor, pipe sizes, grasp modes, and fixture, not confined live switchgear or site-scale routing.

title: Cutaway View Learning for Visually-Guided Assembly with Crane
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Four final-phase insertion geometries are tested. Table I reports one attempt per trial and 100 trials per success-rate cell for proposed variants, privileged ablations, nonprivileged baselines, and open-loop kinodynamic RRT. Policies requiring privileged simulator data are not run in Drake. No reset-and-retry logic is active.
supported_operating_scope: Supports simulator-level final-phase placement of one rectangular beam into four idealized target geometries under stated randomization and a second physics engine. Physical crane execution, broader payloads, joint acceptance, force/damage outcomes, reset, retry, and construction workflow remain outside scope.

title: Reinforcement learning-based motion planning for robotic bricklaying in construction environments
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: The converged policy is tested in 100 consecutive simulated episodes from fixed initial and target brick positions; 82 placements succeed, and pose errors are summarized over successful trials.
supported_operating_scope: Supports the stated UR5e model, one brick, fixed poses, simulator contacts, and shaped phase rewards; pose generalization, physical transfer, mortar, accepted tolerance, multi-brick work, and recovery remain outside scope.

title: Teaching Robot End Effectors to Grasp Construction Tools Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
final_evaluation_summary: Virtual grasping is assessed over a stated 100 trials using a 0.2-m lift threshold; six figure-level rates are reported, but denominator allocation is ambiguous.
supported_operating_scope: Supports the stated PyBullet KUKA environment and lift threshold; physical grasping, tool use, wear, contact uncertainty, and recovery remain outside scope.

title: Harnessing Human Expertise for High-Precision Robotic Assembly in Industrialized Construction: A Sample-Efficient Installer-in-the-Loop Interactive Reinforcement Learning Framework
command_path_summary: Mediated skill/reference, supervisory, or shared-control configuration
